verdict.rationale: Composio exposes documented meta-tools (e.g., COMPOSIO_SEARCH_TOOLS) and an OpenAPI-documented API that let agents discover toolkits/servers programmatically, plus MCP session creation and a live openapi.json confirming a documented API surface. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of programmatic registry queries beyond vendor docs, and no explicit example of a raw catalog-listing API call/response.
